read.thesis: Lennar Q1 FY26 gross margin 15.2% with incentives 14.1%; management calls Q1 the low point, but guides Q2 margin only 15.5%-16% and holds 85,000 deliveries despite a soft market.

triggers.label: Incentives 14.1% vs 14.5% prior
triggers.quote: Sales incentives on deliveries were 14.1%, roughly flat with Q4 of last year at 14.5%

triggers.label: Homebuilding inventory cut to $10.5B
triggers.quote: our total homebuilding inventory has been reduced from just under $20 billion 2 years ago to $10.5 billion today
triggers.highlight: reduced from just under $20 billion 2 years ago to $10.5 billion today

triggers.label: Direct costs down 7% YoY
triggers.quote: In Q1, we achieved just over a 2.5% reduction in direct construction costs from Q4, which represents a 7% year-over-year reduction.

triggers.label: Q1 margin 15.2% called low point
triggers.quote: we believe our Q2 -- our Q1 margin of 15.2% should represent the low point for the year
triggers.highlight: should represent the low point for the year

triggers.label: Institutional buyers sidelined
triggers.quote: The institutional purchasers have been sidelined by political pressures and popular sentiment

guidance.quote: We expect Q2 new orders to be in the range of 21,000 to 22,000 homes
We anticipate our Q2 deliveries to be in the range of 20,000 to 21,000
gross margin should be in the range of 15.5% to 16%
these estimates should produce an EPS range of approximately $1.10 to $1.40 for the quarter
we continue to aim for a full year delivery target of 85,000 homes for the full year

red_flags.label: Gross margin 15.2% with 14.1% incentives
red_flags.quote: Sales incentives on deliveries were 14.1%, roughly flat with Q4 of last year at 14.5%

red_flags.label: Q1 cash use ~$1B from lower ASP
red_flags.quote: It probably relates most to average sales price coming down.

red_flags.label: Overhead rising; SG&A above expectations
red_flags.quote: Our SG&A came in at 9.8%, slightly above expectations

evasions.quote: This is an art, not a science. I can't predetermine today what we're going to do throughout the year.

evasions.topic: Rate buydown cost and margin impact
evasions.quote: I think that we've tried to give as much guidance as we saw through the quarter and not do too much to update that thinking
